name: two-sum-hash-map
explain: Demonstrate the optimal single-pass hash map algorithm for Two Sum (LeetCode 1). Maps each seen integer to its index and tests for complement target - num in O(1) time before insertion, guaranteeing strict linear O(n) runtime and O(n) space.
steps: Iterate through elements and calculate the complement target - num. || Query whether the complement exists in the hash map and return matching index pair immediately. || Record current number and index in hash map before continuing.
expect: Two Sum verified: pair=[0, 1], values=[2, 7], target=9

name: lru-cache-implementation
explain: Demonstrate the optimal Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache (LeetCode 146) combining a hash map with a doubly linked list. Achieves strict O(1) get and put operations with eviction of the least recently accessed item upon exceeding capacity.
steps: Maintain doubly linked list with sentinel head and tail nodes for O(1) node splicing. || Update recency by splicing accessed node directly to the front behind head sentinel. || Evict node immediately preceding tail sentinel and delete its key from hash map upon exceeding capacity.
expect: LRU Cache verified: capacity=2, get(1)=100, evicted key 2, get(2)=-1, get(3)=300
